title: Security Deposit Review Extension: Autopay Reduction
content:
Autopay lowers the extension of the refund review date of a held Security Deposit whose satisfactory payment review is not passed.

**Clause.** Where at least 6 of the secured Electric Service Agreement's payments posted in the 6 months ending on the decision day, the day the review is decided, came through autopay, 2 months come off the extension; where at least 3 but fewer than 6 did, 1 month comes off; otherwise nothing comes off.

## Reduction by autopay payments

| Payments through autopay on the secured agreement in the 6 months ending on the decision day | Months off the extension |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 1 |
| 0, 1 or 2 | Nothing |

The payments counted are those posted on the secured agreement whose payment channel is autopay; payments made by card, online bank transfer, mailed check, pay station or energy assistance agency do not count toward the figure.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical counts)

- 6 autopay payments in the window: 2 months off. With 5, the reduction falls to 1 month.
- 3 autopay payments in the window: 1 month off. With 2, nothing comes off.
- 7 payments in the window, 4 of them through autopay and 3 by card: 4 autopay payments, so 1 month off.
